hints.title: Continuous Prefix and Suffix Clearing
hints.text: Clearing prefix of length i costs i, and clearing suffix of length j costs j. Clearing interior 1s individually costs 2.

hints.title: Transform into Subarray Sum Problem
hints.text: Represent each 1 as weight +1 and each 0 as weight -1. The optimal middle segment corresponds to a minimum subarray sum.

hints.title: Linear Sweep via Kadane Minimum
hints.text: Compute the minimum subarray sum in a single pass to obtain the minimal removal cost.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minimumTime(self, s: str) -> int:
        n = len(s)
        min_sub = 0
        cur = 0
        for ch in s:
            val = 1 if ch == '1' else -1
            cur = min(val, cur + val)
            min_sub = min(min_sub, cur)
        return n + min_sub
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all prefix, suffix, and interior cut boundaries takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Translating to min subarray sum executes in O(N) time with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Transform multi-sided cost equation into Kadane variant.
